description: Read a typed search result as a cited document. Full text/transcripts are opt-in and pageable; metadata and text respect exposure policy. Unknown ID returns an error.

fulltext_offset.description: Start offset into the full text (chars), with include_fulltext

id.description: A typed record id from search (item:9902, pub:30001, video:…, podcast:…, project:…, section:…) or resolve_entity

include_fulltext.description: Default false — set true to append a publication's extracted full text

include_transcript.description: Default false — set true to append the video/podcast transcript

max_chars.description: Cap on the whole returned text body, default/max 25000

transcript_offset.description: Start offset into the transcript (chars), with include_transcript

name: fetch

error.description: Present instead of the record when the id is unknown

title: Fetch one AMIRA record
